feeling: A short phrase that shows what an instrument does with a tune: short notes, one held note, a slide and a fast run.
intent: The same ten seconds for every new instrument, so they can be told apart by ear and by measurement.
listen_for: The held note in the second bar, the slide in the third, and the last bar where everything plays at once.

parts.name: short-notes
parts.change: short lead notes, quarter-note bass, one chord stab

parts.name: held-note
parts.change: the lead holds one note for two beats

parts.name: slide
parts.change: the lead slides up a third, a tom fill at the end

parts.name: everything
parts.change: every part plays at once: a run, chords, a fast bass, a full drum
